title: Blox Settings document
description: Version 1 settings.json. An absent file uses the packaged version 1 defaults without creating a user file.

widgetProfile.title: Blox widget profile
widgetProfile.description: Fresh schema 1. Unknown fields and old formats are rejected. x-blox-uniqueBy requires unique ids and x-blox-orderedRange requires ascending inclusive endpoints; the stdlib validator enforces both. Native fullscreen modes are fixed; QML modes must be declared and verified by the trusted host registry.

timezone.description: local or an IANA identifier available through Python ZoneInfo. blox-timezone is an asserted application format.

terminalSettings.description: Complete terminal configuration. Empty workingDirectory inherits the broker directory; otherwise use an absolute path. x-blox-maxUtf8Bytes asserts valid Unicode and limits the UTF-8 bytes per string. x-blox-terminalBudget limits columns times rows to maxCells, the sum of UTF-8 bytes in argv plus environment keys and values to maxArgvEnvironmentUtf8Bytes, and compact ensure_ascii=true JSON of this settings object to maxEncodedJsonBytes. The ASCII budget also bounds Unicode-literal JSON and leaves request metadata room within the broker 64 KiB line limit. The stdlib validator asserts these application constraints for profiles and standalone provider settings.
